exceptions.reason: Temporary review candidate for webpack-dev-middleware vulnerable to Path Traversal via non-slash-terminated publicPath. GitHub Actions security run 40722772948 and artifact IDs in source_evidence map this advisory to this package; do not infer applicability from aggregate parent counts.
exceptions.applicability: Published @strapi/strapi 5.51.2 imports webpack-dev-middleware only from its webpack admin watcher. The CLI defaults to Vite and treats webpack as deprecated/explicit. Both stock webpack configs set publicPath to `${basePath.replace(/\/$/, '')}/`, which ends in a slash and matches the advisory workaround. Custom webpack configuration and live admin watcher use are unknown; npm still reports the package in both runtime and full reports.
exceptions.mitigation: Use Strapi’s default Vite bundler and stock config; if webpack is used, verify the effective publicPath still ends with `/`. This leaves the vulnerable dependency present and does not cover custom runtime configuration.

exceptions.reason: Temporary review candidate for Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections. GitHub Actions security run 40722772948 and artifact IDs in source_evidence map this advisory to this package; do not infer applicability from aggregate parent counts.
exceptions.applicability: Published core 5.51.2 uses Zod v4 route schemas, including unbounded arrays, but @strapi/utils validates document input by tree traversal and applies route Zod parsing only to extra query/input parameters registered by plugins. Core’s direct safeParse calls are simple license registry response schemas without arrays. No app-level addQueryParams/addInputParams registration was found. Custom plugins or other packages may still provide paths; live plugin/runtime state is not verified.
exceptions.mitigation: No general mitigation verified. Keep custom plugin Zod schemas bounded where possible and track a compatible fix; these observations do not rule out affected paths in other Strapi packages.
